contents_summary: One personally viewed page: two patient-specific serial glucose tables,57 numeric values plus8 missing cells, hospitalization Day1–6 for p1 and Day1–7 for p2; mmol/L. Relative day and measurement-clock conflicts are explicit.

pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Two tables explicitly name first and second patient, map to original case-order p1/p2. All57 numerical glucose readings and8 missing cells independently transcribed from actual rendered page. Numerous readings are new beyond main article. First-patient Table1 6:00 Day2 3.6 differs from main narrative clock04:00 (sampling times not silently merged); second-patient Day1 22:00 value29.6 differs from main narrative daytime peak29.0. Printed dash explanation leaves absent monitoring because not yet hospitalized versus discharged unresolved; no fabricated exact discharge day. LAGE/SDBG repeat main narrative.
limitations: No printed page-specific rights notice; original article source license retained without blanket re-licensing.
Printed day labels are relative hospitalization epochs, with no dates; no assumption that blood was fasting, nor linkage to exact medication-change times.
Typed supplemental observations retain PDF page/cell provenance; quotes never masquerade as immutable JATS segments.
Clinical supplemental data preserved separately from original-source clinical target; values absent from original retained text cannot be represented as though quoted from its immutable segments.
